executive_decision.governing_truth_statement: GSWF is a proven distinct GE OEM refrigerator filter SKU. The GSWF↔GSWF2 relationship (alias, supersession, pack variant, or shared fit) is UNKNOWN on preserved GE authority. BuckParts must not present GSWF and GSWF2 as the same part, printable alias, or interchangeable replacement on filter PDPs until GE OEM evidence supports a typed claim.

safe_copy_rule.gswf_pdp: Keep page H1 OEM token GSWF and GE GSWF product name. Keep GSWF_FILTER_PAGE_CAUTION_NOTE_V1. Do not state GSWF2 is the same part, a replacement, or 'also listed as' equivalent. Use only compare-printed-number / manual / housing-verify language already in trust sections.
safe_copy_rule.gswf2_pdp: Keep GSWF2 H1 and 'GE GSWF2 listing (verify housing)' qualified name. Keep combined caution + GSWF2_FILTER_PAGE_VERIFY_HOUSING_NOTE_V1 (explicit non-interchange). Do not surface GSWF as 'Also listed as' or any equivalence alias.
safe_copy_rule.model_pages_and_recommendations: No confident recommendation language tying GSWF and GSWF2 together; preserve suppress_buy / under-review semantics.
safe_copy_rule.metadata: Generic 'compatible models' meta description is acceptable only alongside on-page caution — do not add equivalence in meta.

alias_surface_rule.scope: Remove mutual cross-token rows from customer-facing PDP alias surfaces for gswf and gswf2 (filter_aliases gswf→GSWF2 and gswf2→GSWF). Retain within-slug OEM echo aliases (gswf→GSWF, gswf2→GSWF2) only if needed for search normalization — they should not render on PDP because they duplicate H1.
alias_surface_rule.rationale: 'Also listed as' is interpreted by homeowners as naming/fit authority; it contradicts caution copy and baseline R04 regression. Search discovery may retain internal alias indexing only if relabeled and gated — default minimum tranche is removal of cross-slug rows, not relabel, to fail closed.
alias_surface_rule.optional_future: If GE later proves typed relationship, re-introduce via FilterPdpLegacySuccessorSection or evidence-gated successor copy — not generic alias card.
